The [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]] contained at least eleven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Rafa III]], [[Rafa IV]], [[Rafa V]] and [[Rafa XI]]. The [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] originated on the Rafa system and were responsible for the construction of the immense plastic pyramids on the worlds of the Rafa system and the mysterious [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]] of Sharu.
